en.text: This is Lecture 4 of the FrontierCS 2 course: Network.

en.text: Each task removes the key idea of a paper from its released code. An agent has five hours to write it back, and it passes only if it beats the authors' code on every metric of every hidden workload.
We start with BBQ, a priority queue built as a circuit. Take sixteen priorities, zero to fifteen, with zero the best.
